Atlanta Gold Buyer Leads

CaratBase sends gold-buyer leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers, starting with the Atlanta metro area. The first 3 leads are free, then each accepted lead costs $40.

How the Leads Work

  • Who they are – People looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring.
  • Local focus – Atlanta first.
  • Simple pricing – After the 3 free leads, you pay $40 only for leads you accept.

Optional website widget

Optionally, a Pro website widget is $12/month (cancel whenever; it drops back to the free version). The free widgets are available at no cost on the widgets page.

FAQ

Does CaratBase cover Atlanta gold-buyer leads? Yes. CaratBase is starting in Atlanta, with leads from people looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring.

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.
